title: 127. Min Cost Climbing Stairs

examples.explanation: Start on stair 1 and climb two stairs to the top.
The minimum cost to reach the top with cost array [1,100,1,1,1,100,1,1,100,1] is 6.

hints: Let the cost to reach a stair depend only on the two preceding stairs.
The answer is the smaller accumulated cost at either of the final two stairs.
